lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: Four hundred and six. Not four hundred and one. I was five short for eleven days, because five of them never came out of the sand at all.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Four hundred and six is the payroll figure. That is the Basin crew list, and I have read the other copy of it, eight hundred years upstream, on a clerk's desk.

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: Then they've got names. That's all I wanted. I'm not going to be able to explain why and I'd rather not be asked.
